The daily ritual.

Morning and evening. From the lightest texture to the richest.

01
Cleanse

Sweep over face and neck with a cotton pad. Lift away make-up and impurities. No rinsing.

02
Treat

Press two or three drops into face and neck. Allow a moment to absorb.

03
Revive

Gently pat a little along the orbital bone, from the inner to the outer corner.

04
Restore

Warm a pea-sized amount and press into face and neck. Follow with SPF by day.
